name: Pirate Attack
description: A band of pirates has spotted your vessel and moves to intercept.

choices.label: Fight them off
choices.outcomeWin: You repel the pirates, but your crew is shaken.
choices.outcomeLose: They board your ship and take half your cargo.

choices.label: Try to outrun them
choices.outcomeWin: You escape into open water, losing only time.
choices.outcomeLose: They catch you easily. You lose cargo to ransom.

choices.label: Pay them off
choices.outcomeWin: They take your coin and let you pass.
choices.outcomeLose: They take your coin and your cargo.

name: Mediterranean Storm
description: Dark clouds gather and the sea turns violent.

choices.label: Ride out the storm
choices.outcomeWin: Your crew's skill sees you through safely.
choices.outcomeLose: The storm damages your hull. Repairs needed at next port.

choices.label: Seek a nearby cove
choices.outcomeWin: You find shelter and wait out the storm safely.
choices.outcomeLose: The cove offers little protection. You take damage.
